slides.text:
Part 2 of the <accent>OpenClaw</accent> series.

You've seen what it can do.
Now let's get it <accent>running</accent> on your machine.

10 minutes. That's all it takes.

slides.heading: What You <accent>Need</accent>
items: An API key (Claude, OpenAI, or DeepSeek)
Terminal access (Mac, Linux, or WSL on Windows)

slides.heading: Step 1: <accent>Install</accent>
slides.body:
One command to install globally.
This gives you the openclaw CLI.

slides.heading: Step 2: <accent>Onboard</accent>
slides.body:
The onboard wizard walks you through
API keys, messaging setup, and daemon config.

slides.heading: Step 3: <accent>Connect</accent> Messaging
slides.body:
Scan a QR code or paste a token.
OpenClaw now lives in your chat app.

terminal.text: > Scan this QR code with WhatsApp:
Connected! Send a message to test.

slides.heading: Step 4: <accent>Test</accent> It
slides.body:
Send your first message.
Watch it think, plan, and execute.

terminal.text: You (WhatsApp): What's the weather in Chennai?

slides.heading: Pro Tips for <accent>Setup</accent>
slides.body:
- Use Docker for always-on server deployments
- Start with Claude as your LLM (best agent performance)
- Connect multiple messaging apps simultaneously
- Set up cron jobs for automated daily summaries
